about_the_game:
Dive into the world of the Romans and relive the last day of Pompeii, the famous ancient city at the foot of Mount Vesuvius.

Help its inhabitants with their daily activities and discover their tragic fate during the volcanic eruption.

A true adventure game: travel back in time and solve the mysteries of the city with Flavia or Flavius, and experience history in a unique and fun way!

Features

  • Accurately recreated city

  • Choice of character and accessories

  • Open world filled with surprises

  • More than 60 characters with their own stories and quests

  • Varied missions in the city’s famous landmarks

  • Rewards in sesterces – the currency of the time

  • Save the inhabitants and escape Mount Vesuvius

  • Discover the life of the Romans

  • Unique comic book style based on archeological archives

Recommended age

From 9 years old to fully enjoy the game's educational benefits.

Why Pompeii?

Although the eruption of Mount Vesuvius destroyed the city in 79 AD and claimed

many lives, it also preserved a part of Roman history for future generations.

Discover this ancient city like never before.

Created by the Institut Le Rosey

A collaborative project developed under the direction of a Pompeii expert, with the

participation of students — who composed the original music and contributed to

game design, graphic design, and testing — and produced by DNA Studios.

short_description: Danger in Pompei is an adventure game telling the story of the last day in the famous Roman city of Pompei. Discover the accurately recreated city, learn about the everyday life of Romans and solve the mysteries to save those you love from the Vesuvio!
